payload.description:
**Blocked by:** the Principal seam and the organization records. Parallel with the Cognito token work.

Worker registration mints a token stored hashed; the worker presents it and resolves to a worker Principal. This closes the question recorded as still open in docs/DESIGN_CHALLENGES.md, how workers authenticate their chunk POSTs.

Browser routes must reject a worker principal and worker routes must reject a user principal. The shared X-Chatticus-Invoke-Key stays what it is, a CloudFront-to-Lambda check, and is not a caller identity.

**Done when:** behave and pytest cover both rejections, and a development worker claims and completes a turn using a minted credential.

**Note for scheduling:** this must merge before default deny is flipped, or every worker breaks at the same moment.
payload.title: Issue and verify per-worker credentials
